page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features a dedicated CPU allocation with 96 physical cores and 96 vCPUs, operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The processor is an Intel Xeon 8369HB, configured with a single thread per core, ensuring that each vCPU maps directly to a dedicated physical execution core without hyperthreading.

The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the dedicated core configuration and high clock speed of the Intel Xeon processor, this instance offers high compute density and predictable performance for workloads sensitive to resource sharing. The balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes it suitable for compute-heavy applications, high-performance web serving, batch processing, and enterprise application hosting where dedicated CPU execution is required.
